decisions.decision: Foundational built layer by layer (persistence via one worker, app and MCP core inline) instead of dispatch-briefs waves
decisions.why: tasks.md has no wave markers, so the script grouped dependent tasks (T006/T007) as one parallel wave of trivial edits

decisions.decision: Own constant-time bearer check in the admission middleware
decisions.why: the SDK middleware never calls the verifier for a missing token, so those refusals could not be logged

decisions.decision: Tools registered through a raw-handler wrapper (addTool) with our own schema validation; tool errors travel as JSON text content
decisions.why: uniform error contract; structuredContent that does not match the output schema is rejected by strict clients
decisions.rejected: typed mcp.AddTool; error object in structuredContent

decisions.decision: Revisions start at 1 and only assistant operations bump them
decisions.why: ExpectedRevision 0 can mean no check; warning text 'changed by the assistant' is always true

decisions.decision: Connection.Stop force-closes after the 5 s grace period and returns nil
decisions.why: idle StateNew connections from client pools made Shutdown hit the deadline and flake

decisions.decision: Skills extension hand-rolled in skills.go without a provider interface
decisions.why: no released go-sdk support; one implementation, isolated in one file
decisions.rejected: pinning go-sdk main; an interface with one implementation

decisions.decision: remove_campaign_player also removes the character from encounters; update_encounter re-checks the removal set after confirmation
decisions.why: matches the confirmation text; prevents removing a combatant the GM never confirmed (SC-003)
decisions.rejected: plain roster omit; trusting the pre-confirmation roster

decisions.decision: Classify tool errors by kind: domain.ErrInvalidInput / domain.ErrNotFound marked where errors arise (app checks and validation helpers, domain unknown-combatant, store user-caused guards); adapter uses errors.Is only
decisions.why: removes the word-list heuristic that would report new validation messages as internal; messages unchanged so the desktop UI is unaffected
decisions.rejected: FieldError at all 84 domain sites (larger); keeping the heuristic with a test (misses new messages)

decisions.decision: Advertised tool schemas carry minimums, quantity max, non-empty ids and enums; arguments still validate against the inferred schema
decisions.why: domain checks answer with messages that name the field and range (FR-017, SC-005)
decisions.rejected: validating the constrained schema: the SDK error names no field and reads like "0/1 is less than 1.000000"

decisions.decision: The store campaign save takes a dropped player's character out of the campaign's encounters in the same transaction, so remove_campaign_player is one save and one event
decisions.why: baseline 001 US1/AC3 already requires it, and only one transaction makes the removal atomic
decisions.rejected: a compensating second save: it cannot restore encounter membership the first save removed

decisions.decision: The HTTP handler keeps the request context as a context value; desktop confirmations also end when it ends
decisions.why: the SDK drops request cancellation for clients older than 2026-07-28 (Claude Desktop through the bridge)
decisions.rejected: forwarding notifications/cancelled: the stateless endpoint cannot match it to the waiting call

decisions.decision: AddPartyAP returns capped and ExecuteSaveMonsterTemplates returns ReplacedExisting
decisions.why: the rule result comes from the same gate hold as the write (Constitution II)
decisions.rejected: a second read in the adapter, racy and outside the gate

decisions.decision: GM accepted that removing a player in the campaign editor also removes their character from the campaign encounters
decisions.why: checked in the manual pass; matches baseline 001 US1/AC3

concerns.note: T088 manual validation is open: GUI toggle/persistence, interactive Claude Code elicitation and skills, live STAT refresh timing, Claude Desktop with the desktop confirmation dialog, and the §4a timed trials need a person. The spec is left at implementing, not marked complete.
Claude Desktop's real request timeout versus the 50 s desktop confirmation window is unverified (research R5); record it during T088.
Plain domain errors are classified into invalid_input/not_found by wording (isValidationMessage, notFoundMarker); an unexpected message falls back to the generic internal code.
-race runs of app+mcpserver take about 11 minutes because every test migrates a fresh SQLite database.

Desktop behavior change: removing a player in the campaign editor now also takes their character out of the campaign's encounters (before, the character stayed). This follows baseline 001 US1/AC3 but the GM will notice it.
T088 (manual GUI, Claude Desktop and interactive Claude Code validation) is still open, so the spec is not marked complete.
